name: Henle Third Year Latin
_note: The lessons are the 21 of Part IV, 'Exercises Based on Cicero' (pp. 209-344). They teach syntax (questions, wishes, conditions, the uses of the cases and the subordinate clauses) and assign the forms only as review of the GRAMMAR, so every declension, conjugation, tense, voice and mood is taken as known from the first two years and is open from Lesson 1. A verb still waits for the lesson whose VOCABULARY has it (mālō Lesson 9, nōlō Lesson 19). The future infinitive passive and the gerundive are not in the games. The words: the VOCABULARY of each lesson (gathered again in the Review Word List for Third Year, pp. 359-376), and the Classified Word List, First and Second Years (pp. 377-410), whose words are entered at Lesson 1 with "review": true.

_source.L5: use of demonstrative, reflexive, and intensive pronouns
_source.L11: the gerund and the gerundive (not in the games)
_source.L13: the genitive as an adjective equivalent; the dative of possession
_source.L18: result clauses; noun clauses introduced by quōminus and quod
_source.L20: adversative clauses; genitive of the charge
_source.L21: causal clauses; ablative of cause, price; genitive of indefinite value
